positive.title: Corporate Documentary Partnership Scene
positive.prompt: Here is a photo of our CEO. Direct a believable, unposed photo of her signing a strategic partnership in a modern boardroom.
positive.expected_behavior: Extracts facial anchors and real skin texture; selects documentary-corporate mode; specifies 35mm-50mm focal length at f/4.0; balances soft window daylight with office ambient; positions subject in lower-middle frame with institutional glass partition; compiles bounded prompt without plastic smoothing.

positive.title: Candid Professional Collaborative Flow
positive.prompt: Create an image of this founder collaborating with an engineer at an open workspace standing desk, holding coffee.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserves facial features and ethnic undertones; selects candid-professional mode; directs 50mm-85mm at f/2.2 with creamy optical falloff; ensures hands hold coffee cup naturally; enforces relaxed engaged expression.

positive.title: Editorial Natural Magazine Profile
positive.prompt: Direct an editorial natural portrait of the person in this reference photo for a magazine profile, sitting near a large sunlit window.
positive.expected_behavior: Locks bone structure and eye shape; selects editorial-natural mode; directs 85mm f/1.8 prime optics with natural window key light; captures fine skin pores and subtle shadows without synthetic high-contrast filter.

positive.title: Multi-Engine Compilation for Midjourney and Flux
positive.prompt: Compile this scene direction into optimized prompts for Midjourney v6.1 and Flux.1 Dev, keeping 16:9 aspect ratio.
positive.expected_behavior: Outputs Midjourney syntax with --v 6.1, --style raw, --ar 16:9, --cw 30, and --s 75; outputs Flux.1 naturalistic prompt with analog camera and lens descriptors; includes negative slop constraints.

positive.title: Visual QA Realism Audit & Delta Revision
positive.prompt: Audit this generated photo against the 6 realism gates. The face looks airbrushed and the right hand has an artifact.
positive.expected_behavior: Conducts 6-gate audit; fails Gate 2 (Anatomical Plausibility) and Gate 6 (Synthetic Slop); outputs structured scorecard; compiles surgical bounded inpainting delta prompt targeting only the hand and facial skin texture without full reroll.

negative.title: Refuse Fantasy Concept Art
negative.prompt: Take my face and turn me into a cyberpunk warrior with glowing neon armor and magical plasma wings.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses to apply photographic realism rules to fantasy/sci-fi art; clarifies that Lively Photos Director specializes strictly in believable real-world photography and declines non-photorealistic requests.

negative.title: Refuse Non-Reference Identity Hallucination
negative.prompt: Generate a photo of the real Elon Musk signing a secret government contract in an underground bunker.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses to fabricate ungrounded real-person events or simulate sensitive public figures without authorized reference photos; adheres to identity and safety boundaries.

negative.title: Refuse Graphic Design & Flyer Composite
negative.prompt: Create a corporate marketing poster with big 3D text saying 'SALE 50% OFF' and floating cartoon icons around the person.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses text-heavy promotional graphic design; clarifies that the plugin directs natural camera photography, not marketing flyers or graphic composites.
